title: The wall sit test: how long can you hold it?
caption: Wall sit test: how long can you hold one? Take the test, then do your level every day: High Wall Sit, Wall Sit, Paused Squat or Split Squat. Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How long can you hold a wall sit? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Stop when your thighs start to rise. The last second you held is your number.

overlays.text: Back flat on the wall. Slide down until your thighs are level. Count the seconds.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when 20 seconds feels easy.

overlays.text: Start here. High Wall Sit. 20 seconds. Back on the wall, slide down only a little.

scenes.footer: Move on when 30 seconds feels easy.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 seconds. Back flat on the wall, thighs level, hold.

scenes.footer: Off the wall now. Move on when all 8 feel easy.

overlays.text: Paused Squat. 8 reps. Squat down, hold two seconds at the bottom, stand up.

scenes.footer: Your legs are strong. Now train them one at a time.

overlays.text: Split Squat. 8 each side. One foot forward, one back, lower straight down, stand up.

scenes.footer: Same wall, same count. Write down your seconds.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the wall sit test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How many seconds did you get?
